Suppose, in a major drug conspiracy case, that the Crown calls fifty witnesses and spends an average of one day on examination in chief of each of them. That's fifty days of evidence. If the decision is made to go to a discovery process, the defence must be allowed to examine ALL Crown witnesses, for as long as needed.
